newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet says to pay cash for Atlas.
newsitem.headline: Valmet says to pay cash for Atlas.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said on Wednesday it would finance the purchase of UK engineering group Atlas Converting Equipment by a combination of cash flow and existing credit facilities.

"Valmet has cash reserves...and we also have previously agreed lines of credit. We will do this (finance the purchase) in practice by a combination of these," Valmet financing director Pekka Holtta told Reuters at a briefing.
He said the acquisition would not have any major effect on the group's equity to assets ratio -- 42.8 percent at end-April.
Valmet earlier said it was offering to buy Atlas Converting Equipment for about 700 million markka.
